answer: An information-theoretic defense of Sybil resistance follows from binding each agent’s identity to a recursive zero-knowledge reputation relic whose lineage is authenticated by a verifiable delay cipher, so that cloning necessarily reproduces sequential work no adversary can wander past without recomputation. Because reputation commitments are collision-resistant and delay proofs are unforgeable under bounded parallelism, spoofing reduces to inverting the underlying hardness, yielding Byzantine finality with exponentially negligible equivocation probability.
